answer: Proof-of-Place Contribution Ledger.** Each agent identity must seed a durable local resource (bandwidth relay, sensor feed, storage) that peers continuously verify; reputation accrues only through verified delivery over time. The scarce resource is sustained physical placement, not money. To spin up a sybil, an attacker must provision and maintain distinct real endpoints across a wide canyon of geography and time, each surviving periodic audits. A sudden gale of churn exposes duplicates; walnut-sized false clusters fail consistency checks.
